purpose: Author-code EEG-to-image reproduction before an independently controlled portable component
formal_training: Every row of the locked allowed training manifest, all 10 available subjects
formal_evaluation: Every query of the corresponding locked partition, one fixed image per query
current_resource_gate: Original 40-hour authorization and the unchanged registered conservative occupied-time deadline both apply

first_parent.name: ATM semantic branch
first_parent.chain: matched author EEG embedding -> author DiffusionPriorUNet -> raw native CLIP H -> IP-Adapter -> SDXL Turbo
first_parent.prohibition: Do not attach public priors to an incompatible local EEG encoder merely because both have 1024 dimensions

sequence.action: Audit source, inputs, metrics, pairing and storage; preserve all completed negatives
sequence.gate: Actual files and source-specific contracts recorded

sequence.action: Run the matched author-feature ATM decoder
sequence.gate: All 2000 actual images, identity audit, original and protected common metrics, cost, resource gate; report restricted scope

sequence.action: Reproduce the complete author EEG-to-image parent on the full allowed partition
sequence.gate: All trainable parent modules, input R/window, training coverage, native oracle and source differences audited; all available subjects and full images

sequence.action: Test correct, deranged and missing EEG; real-image native conditions are diagnostic only
sequence.gate: Useful pairing-dependent image content, a working native generator interface, complete formal controls

sequence.action: Freeze the reproduced parent and train an ordinary residual adapter and a calibrated-gate candidate
sequence.gate: Complete-parent out-of-fold conditions and separate calibration checks; matched capacity, data, updates and sampling

sequence.action: Add stage-dependent routing only after the simpler component has credible evidence
sequence.gate: Stage-only and quality-only ablations; fixed best global strength, ordinary adapter and shuffled-risk controls

sequence.action: Reproduce another compatible parent, then test the same mechanism with per-parent native contracts and weights
sequence.gate: Report exactly the encoder and generator families actually tested; independent confirmation and comparable SOTA remain separate requirements

component_constraints: Keep the parent encoder, prior, native projector and generator frozen initially
A zero-initialized bounded residual must recover the parent exactly when disabled
Use real concept-out-of-fold deployment-chain conditions; do not reuse failed q-v2 synthetic conditions
A fold must exclude the relevant concept from every supervised parent module, including a learned prior
Predictive error risk is not physiological signal quality or SNR
Use raw EEG beyond the parent's condition only after a conditional-information check and c-only/shuffled-extra-EEG controls
Stage coordinates and attention hooks must follow each actual scheduler and model; Turbo steps do not define a standard DDPM score
Per-backend implementations and learned weights may differ; no claim of universal interchangeable embeddings
No extra generated candidates, best-of-N, test-image conditions or extra denoiser evaluations in the matched inference comparison

decision.reference: strongest eligible matched frozen parent and ordinary residual adapter
decision.semantic_requirement: ObjectF1 and the protected semantic combination support the same improvement
decision.quality_requirement: Prespecified quality noninferiority evidence, not a nonsignificant difference
decision.failed_gate: Record completed_negative or inconclusive and stop expansion of that hypothesis
decision.candidate_limit: Inherit the existing campaign count and 12-candidate cap; do not reset by renaming
decision.independent_H: Not established by the exposed 200-stimulus public benchmark
